title: Pollinations gets a command line
summary:
A terminal-friendly alpha CLI arrived alongside two additions to the community app showcase.

The new alpha `polli` CLI brings text, chat, image, audio, and video generation to terminals and AI agents. It also handles transcription, file uploads, model discovery, and account usage, with JSON output for scripts.

The approved IntraMind / AlessiaBot listing was added to the catalog and Recent Apps section. The README refresh also corrected attribution for an AI video generator entry.

kre8.info, which creates short-form and faceless videos from a prompt, was added to the business app catalog, README showcase, and App Greenhouse.

daily.title: Pollinations from your terminal
daily.text: Use the alpha `polli` CLI to generate text, images, audio, and video, transcribe audio, or upload local files. It works interactively or in scripts with `--json` output. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
